The University of California (UC) system is not only one of the world’s most influential public university systems but also the benchmark for public universities across the United States. With 10 campuses across multiple cities in California, the UC system offers world-class academic resources [...] ### The list of UC schools in California

There are 10 schools in the UC system. Except for UC San Francisco, which does not have an undergraduate program, they all offer undergraduate and graduate degrees. Here is the list of all UC schools.

results.title: University of California Insights: Campuses, Courses & More
results.content: The State of California’s Higher Education System has three primary public segments: the University of California (UC), the California State University (CSU) and the California Community Colleges. The UCs, 10 in all, make up the most selective tier of public colleges in the state and are highly competitive. Nine of the UCs grant degrees from Bachelor’s to PhD, while one offers only graduate and doctoral degrees. The second tier comprises 31 Cal State Schools or CSUs offering over 4,100 master’s [...] All UC campuses have a common online application portal. The undergraduate programmes in nine UC schools share the same application format, while the University of San Francisco, which offers only graduate programmes, has a different application format. The UC application deadlines are relatively early compared to many US colleges. Applications are accepted from November 1 through November 30, but they open as early as August 1, so make sure to track the timelines closely.
